Method of Attack: Malicious apps impersonate cryptocurrency exchanges to steal login credentials and one-time passwords (OTP) by requesting notification access permission to read, dismiss, and control notifications from other apps including SMS and email apps. They present fake login forms to phish credentials and intercept 2FA codes delivered via notifications.
Phishing via fake login forms and notification access to steal credentials and OTPs.
Discoverer: Lukas Stefanko, Android malware researcher at ESET
Impacted Systems: Android devices running Android 5.0 (KitKat) and above
Attack Vector: Malicious Android apps uploaded to Google Play store impersonating legitimate cryptocurrency exchange apps, requesting notification access permission to intercept OTPs and credentials.
Notification access permission abuse in Android apps.
